shape: Ring / donut room (N+S gates with two arc routes)
description: Ring-shaped room with the floor wrapping around an interior obstruction. The two portals sit on roughly opposite sides; reaching one from the other requires walking one of the TWO arcs that wrap the interior: a short east arc (nn0ofu → skuie0 → 3d8id1 → yslthu) or a longer west arc (nn0ofu → uiybk0 → d9tkl4 → 0c7njg → wa9mxo → i72pls → dhxyya → yslthu).

portals.south: spawn_south at (7.56, 19.79) — gate on the south (high-Z) side
portals.north: spawn_north at (11.14, -23.85) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, slightly east of center

anchors.description: north entry hub — east arc start (matches nn0ofu)
south entry hub — east arc end (matches yslthu)
west arc - first step from north hub (matches uiybk0)

traversalNotes: Direct N→S via EAST ARC (shorter): spawn_north → north_inner → east_arc_n → east_arc_s → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops.
Alternative via WEST ARC (longer, more anchors for objective dispatch): spawn_north → north_inner → west_arc_n1 → … → west_arc_s3 → south_inner → spawn_south. 9 hops.
RING TOPOLOGY: the two arcs do NOT cross-connect except at north_inner and south_inner — the interior of the ring is not walkable. Don't emit cross-arc shortcuts.
DISPATCH RULE: objective in the east half → via east arc; objective in the west half → via west arc. Pick the shorter arc to the objective.
